plain_english: Now the rite described by Shiva is set forth for attaining disciplehood: when a teacher wishes to appoint one established in the vow into disciplehood, guruhood, or adept-hood.
sanskrit_cite: atha putrakatvasiddhyai nirūpyate śivanirūpito @tra vidhiḥ yadā tu samayasthasya putrakatve niyojanam gurutve sādhakatve vā kartumicchati daiśikaḥ

plain_english: After performing consecration, on the second day one should draw the mandala in the collective rite and elsewhere as stated.
sanskrit_cite: tadādhivāsaṃ kṛtvāhni dvitīye maṇḍalaṃ likhet sāmudāyikayāge@tha tathānyatra yathoditam

plain_english: By the count of six, eight, and double twenty-four, the five-wheel system is called in the scripture named Shri-prior.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaḍaṣṭataddviguṇitacaturviṃśatisaṃkhyayā cakrapañcakamākhyātaṃ śāstre śrīpūrvasaṃjñite

plain_english: Thirty-two and its double, in the Shri-mat-Traishira view, and the connection with countless wheels, are described in the Shri-Siddha beginning.
sanskrit_cite: dvātriṃśattaddviguṇitaṃ śrīmattraiśirase mate asaṃkhyacakrasaṃbandhaḥ śrīsiddhādau nirūpitaḥ

plain_english: Therefore, as the sacrifice is measured by the wheel, one should worship accordingly; by that, here one should draw three tridents.
sanskrit_cite: tasmādyathātathā yāgaṃ yāvaccakreṇa saṃmitam pūjayedyena tenātra triśūlatrayamālikhet

plain_english: In the three tridents, the three goddesses, by rotational course and by middle-left-right distinction, should become fully worshipped.
sanskrit_cite: triśūlatritaye devītrayaṃ paryāyavṛttitaḥ madhyasavyānyabhedena pūrṇaṃ saṃpūjitaṃ bhavet

plain_english: Maintenance before the mandala will be taught briefly: having drawn the mandala, one wipes it with scented cloth.
sanskrit_cite: vartanā maṇḍalasyāgre saṃkṣepādupadekṣyate ālikhya maṇḍalaṃ gandhavastreṇaivāsya mārjanam

plain_english: Having bathed, the guru, before the mandala here, should worship the external deities and the door deities at the door place.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtvā snāto guruḥ prāgvanmaṇḍalāgre@tra devatāḥ bāhyagāḥ pūjayeddvāradeśe ca dvāradevatāḥ

plain_english: In the front part of the mandala, from the northeast direction in order up to the southeast, one should fully worship Ganesha and the others up to the field protectors.
sanskrit_cite: maṇḍalasya purobhāge tadaiśānadiśaḥ kramāt āgneyyantaṃ gaṇeśādīn kṣetrapāntānprapūjayet

plain_english: Ganapati, guru, Parama, Paramesthi, and the prior-siddha speech-field-lord, thus seven are named in the guru-row rite to be fully worshipped by our gurus.
sanskrit_cite: gaṇapatiguruparamākhyāḥ parameṣṭhī pūrvasiddhavākkṣetrapatiḥ iti saptakamākhyātaṃ gurupaṅktividhau prapūjyamasmadgurubhiḥ

plain_english: Then, having taken command, the support power and related deities, worshipped with flowers, incense, and so forth, are sufficient from the trident root onward.
sanskrit_cite: tata ājñāṃ gṛhītvā tu puṣpadhūpādipūjitam pūjyamādhāraśaktyādi śūlamūlātprabhṛtyalam

plain_english: Up to Shiva, at the end of the white lotus, among the three tridents in order, true being should be in the middle trident together with the supreme.
sanskrit_cite: śivāntaṃ sitapadmānte triśūlānāṃ traye kramāt madhyaśūle madhyagaḥ syātsadbhāvaḥ parayā saha

plain_english: On the left, together with another, the nine-souled one is right-going and supreme; on the trident's right, standing on the middle peak, is Rati-crown.
sanskrit_cite: vāme cāparayā sākaṃ navātmā dakṣagaṃ param triśūle dakṣiṇe madhyaśṛṅgastho ratiśekharaḥ

plain_english: May it be together with supreme and lower powers: on the right Bhairava abides supremely, on the left on the trident, standing in the middle, the nine-souled one with another.
sanskrit_cite: syātparāparayā sākaṃ dakṣe bhairavasatpare vāme triśūle madhyastho navātmāparayā saha

plain_english: May it be supreme, together with the supreme power, on the left side, and Bhairava; thus, when Shri Para Devi is established in the all-pervading state.
sanskrit_cite: syātpare parayā sākaṃ vāmāre saṃśca bhairavaḥ itthaṃ sarvagatatve śrīparādevyāḥ sthite sati

plain_english: The sacrifice becomes fully complete from that seat alone; therefore even on one trident, in sacrifice, one should contemplate that established.
sanskrit_cite: yāgo bhavetsusaṃpūrṇastadadhiṣṭhānamātrataḥ ekaśūle@pyato yāge cintayettadadhiṣṭhitam

plain_english: Not knowing the rite, knowing the procedure, thus spoken by Trishika; then in the middle, so on the right, on the left, on the peak, and everywhere.
sanskrit_cite: avidhijño vidhānajña ityevaṃ trīśikoditam tato madhye tathā dakṣe vāme śṛṅge ca sarvataḥ

plain_english: One should worship as one self up to the world guardians' weapons, and as supreme; one should fully honor all deities.
sanskrit_cite: lokapālāstraparyantamekātmatvena pūjayet paratvena ca sarvāsāṃ devatānāṃ prapūjayet

plain_english: The glorious lord, mother-presence, uninjured; then also by enjoyment sacrifice, the knowledge limb, the Bhairava octad.
sanskrit_cite: śrīmantaṃ mātṛsadbhāvabhaṭṭārakamanāmayam tato@pi bhogayāgena vidyāṅgaṃ bhairavāṣṭakam

plain_english: The pair and wheel goddesses, in their own place, one should worship outside; world guardians with weapons, with sandal, flowers, drinks, and so on.
sanskrit_cite: yāmalaṃ cakradevīśca svasthāne pūjayedbahiḥ lokapālānastrayutāngandhapuṣpāsavādibhiḥ

plain_english: One should worship with supreme devotion, free from wealth-deceit; then of pot, weapon, vase, circle, place, self.
sanskrit_cite: pūjayetparayā bhaktyā vittaśāṭhyavivarjitaḥ tataḥ kumbhāstrakalaśīmaṇḍalasthānalātmanām

plain_english: One should do investigation of five from nondual meditation; but those who do not find that nondual pervasion, Shiva-natured.
sanskrit_cite: pañcānāmanusandhānaṃ kuryādadvayabhāvanāt ye tu tāmadvayavyāptiṃ na vindanti śivātmikām

plain_english: By mantra channel application, they enter the nondual path; having exited by their own right from the circle-dwelling, from the left.
sanskrit_cite: mantranāḍīprayogeṇa te viśantyadvaye pathi svadakṣiṇena niḥsṛtya maṇḍalasthasya vāmataḥ

plain_english: Having entered by another and exited, in pot place, in pitcher, in fire place, and thus in order, until in one's own left.
sanskrit_cite: praviśyānyena niḥsṛtya kumbhasthe karkarīgate vahnisthe ca krameṇetthaṃ yāvatsvasminsvavāmataḥ

plain_english: By root-investigation force, with prana-thread covering — thus unity-flashing self — pervasion-consciousness shines.
sanskrit_cite: mūlānusandhānabalātprāṇatantūmbhane sati itthamaikyasphurattātmā vyāptisaṃvitprakāśate

plain_english: Then special worship, made of non-duality — steeped in Shiva-nondual nectar — that indeed is supreme.
sanskrit_cite: tato viśeṣapūjāṃ ca kuryādadvayabhāvitām yacchivādvayapīyūṣasaṃsiktaṃ paramaṃ hi tat

plain_english: By that — of the bound soul's argha flowers fragrance and liquor — the view of Shiva-nonduality is purification, supreme making.
sanskrit_cite: tenārghapuṣpagandhāderāsavasya paśoratha yā śivādvayatādṛṣṭiḥ sā śuddhiḥ paramīkṛtiḥ

plain_english: Before the Lord one should offer living beings and elements arisen from that — perfected unperfected mixed, whatever moving or still.
sanskrit_cite: nivedayedvibhoragre jīvāndhātūṃstadutthitān siddhānasiddhānvyāmiśrānyadvā kiṃciccarācaram

plain_english: Seen sprinkled witnessed, obtained and joined — extinguished hero-victim — he is eightfold supreme.
sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭaprokṣitasaṃdraṣṭṛprālabdhopāttayojitaḥ nirvāpito vīrapaśuḥ so@ṣṭadhottaratottamaḥ

plain_english: In order, never to be given to the unworthy — the Shiva-used oblation indeed not everyone is worthy to eat.
sanskrit_cite: yathottaraṃ na dātavyamayogyebhyaḥ kadācana śivopayuktaṃ hi havirna sarvo bhoktumarhati

plain_english: Whoever, though initiation-devoid, impelled by Shiva-will-rite, eats with devotion — complete, he would be a well-cultivated samayin.
sanskrit_cite: yastu dīkṣāvihīno@pi śivecchāvidhicoditaḥ bhaktyāśnāti sa saṃpūrṇaḥ samayī syātsubhāvitaḥ

plain_english: Seen and looked upon indeed, by rays-kindled eye-offering — sprinkled only, moistened by argha-vessel drops.
sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭo@valokitaścaiva kiraṇeddhadṛgarpaṇāt prokṣitaḥ kevalaṃ hyarghapātravipruḍbhirukṣitaḥ

plain_english: The complete seer of the shown, fully worshipped mandala — commenced, purified by the spoken triad — he too should shake.
sanskrit_cite: saṃdraṣṭā darśitāśeṣasamyakpūjitamaṇḍalaḥ prālabdha uktatritayasaṃskṛtaḥ so@pi dhūnayet

plain_english: One would tremble, flow, stiffen, dissolve, in order — taken up in sacrifice-presence, pacified by weapons and winds.
sanskrit_cite: kampeta prasravetstabdhaḥ pralīno vā yathottaram upātto yāgasānnidhye śamitaḥ śastramārutaiḥ

plain_english: Joined by cause-abandonment method, from Shiva-union — extinguished by practiced guru-life-breath-mind offering.
sanskrit_cite: yojitaḥ kāraṇatyāgakrameṇa śivayojanāt nirvāpitaḥ kṛtābhyāsaguruprāṇamanorpaṇāt

plain_english: By southern fire, from gentle-kala-net dissolution — thus indeed at first, resort to the supreme form by becoming one.
sanskrit_cite: dakṣiṇenāgninā saumyakalājālavilāpanāt tathāhyādau paraṃ rūpamekībhāvena saṃśrayet

plain_english: Therefore, by fiery practice one should enter the flame-garland, and by the left path of the bound soul melt the moon-ray net with heat.
sanskrit_cite: tasmādāgneyacāreṇa jvālāmālāmucāviśet paśorvāmena candrāṃśujālaṃ tāpena gālayet

plain_english: Resting in the navel wheel with breath-rays, becoming supreme by one's own power, one should here wrap the living being with the living being.
sanskrit_cite: nābhicakre@tha viśrāmyetprāṇaraśmigaṇaiḥ saha paro bhūtvā svaśaktyātra jīvaṃ jīvena veṣṭayet

plain_english: Heating by the sun of one's own consciousness, one should melt part by part; then quickly bring the net of parts to unity in the self.
sanskrit_cite: svacitsūryeṇa saṃtāpya drāvayet kalāṃ kalām tato drutaṃ kalājālaṃ prāpayyaikatvamātmani

plain_english: With force, uproot from essence this karma-bound one who nourishes and completes all principles.
sanskrit_cite: samastatattvasaṃpūrṇamāpyāyanavidhāyinam unmūlayeta saṃrambhātkarmabaddhamamuṃ rasāt

plain_english: Then, by the yoga of uprooting and unwrapping, revolving left, one becomes the nourisher of one's own breath, full of kundali nectar.
sanskrit_cite: tata unmūlanodveṣṭayogādvāmaṃ paribhraman kuṇḍalyamṛtasaṃpūrṇasvakaprāṇaprasevakaḥ

plain_english: The filament of nectar from the heart lotus, taken by leftward circuit, melts the tissue by gaining ascent to the heart center.
sanskrit_cite: vāmāvartakramopāttahṛtpadmāmṛtakesaraḥ hṛtkarṇikārūḍhilābhādojodhātuṃ vilāpitam

plain_english: Taking the pure moon essence, slightly red and yellow, into the breath-body that is like the tip of an elephant's trunk.
sanskrit_cite: śuddhasomātmakaṃ sāramīṣallohitapītalam ādāya karihastāgrasadṛśe prāṇavigrahe

plain_english: Having exited suddenly by the left path of one's own self, one should enter, nourishing the heart-lotus moon wheel called apāna.
sanskrit_cite: niḥsṛtya jhaṭiti svātmavāmamārgeṇa saṃviśet āpyāyayannapānākhyacandracakrahṛdambuje

plain_english: That situated deity wheel should be nourished by that essence; by this method, all rasas, blood, and the rest are nourished.
sanskrit_cite: sthitaṃ taddevatācakraṃ tena sāreṇa tarpayet anena vidhinā sarvānrasaraktādikāṃstathā

plain_english: One should gather the tissues in group sequence, one by one, or only in the middle of the collision of sun, moon, and fire.
sanskrit_cite: dhātūnsamāharetsaṃghakramādekaikaśo@thavā kevalaṃ tvathavāgnīnduravisaṃghaṭṭamadhyagam

plain_english: Then, taking the living being that is light-form called breath-power, one should equalize the living being by the goddess wheel through meditation.
sanskrit_cite: jyotīrūpamatha prāṇaśaktyākhyaṃ jīvamāharet jīvaṃ samarasīkuryāddevīcakreṇa bhāvanāt

plain_english: That itself is the chief nourishment: the identity of enjoyer and enjoyed; that great one is the fire-casket, blossoming, three-cornered, time-self.
sanskrit_cite: tadeva tarpaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ bhogyabhoktrātmataiva sā agnisaṃpuṭaphullārṇatryaśrakālātmako mahān

plain_english: When, in a half-ghatika sequence, rest-yoga occurs amid blood and similar essence-flow movements, the mass is present.
sanskrit_cite: piṇḍo raktādisāraughacālanākarṣaṇādiṣu itthaṃ viśrāntiyogena ghaṭikārdhakrame sati

plain_english: By a hundred repetitions, pacification of the bound soul occurs; having practiced there for some time with undivided mind.
sanskrit_cite: āvṛttiśatayogena paśornirvāpaṇaṃ bhavet kṛtvā katipayaṃ kālaṃ tatrābhyāsamananyadhīḥ

plain_english: As stated in the Cintamani, by that form the yogi obtains siddhi without doubt; that secret is clear like prana.
sanskrit_cite: yathā cintāmaṇau proktaṃ tena rūpeṇa yogavit niḥśaṅkaḥ siddhimāpnoti gopyaṃ tatprāṇavatsphuṭam

plain_english: Even for an unseen bound soul, the rite is thus; entered into the sacrificial ground, he is killed there and accomplished.
sanskrit_cite: parokṣe@pi paśāvevaṃ vidhiḥ syādyojanaṃ prati praveśito yāgabhuvi hatastatraiva sādhitaḥ

plain_english: One joined to the cakra there is called a hero-victim; but one killed elsewhere is treated by totality or partly.
sanskrit_cite: cakrajuṣṭaśca tatraiva sa vīrapaśurucyate yastvanyatrāpi nihataḥ sāmastyenāṃśato@pivā

plain_english: Offered to the deity, that is indeed held to be an external victim; kingdom, gain, stability, devotion to Shiva, and identity with that follow.
sanskrit_cite: devāya vinivedyeta sa vai bāhyapaśurmataḥ rājyaṃ lābho@tha tatsthairyaṃ śive bhaktistadātmatā

plain_english: Shiva-knowledge, attainment of the mantra-world, retinue, and union with that belong to the bound soul by equality from external or hero dharma.
sanskrit_cite: śivajñānaṃ mantralokaprāptistatparivāratā tatsāyujyaṃ paśoḥ sāmyādbāhyādervīradharmaṇaḥ

plain_english: Flowers and the like also share that gain; by Shiva worship, one means, the lord of gods is of the nature of blessing the universe.
sanskrit_cite: puṣpādayo@pi tallābhabhāginaḥ śivapūjayā ekopāyena deveśo viśvānugrahaṇātmakaḥ

plain_english: By sacrifice alone he blesses; what is not moving and still? Therefore even a non-hero, though joined with doubt and the like, is compassionate.
sanskrit_cite: yāgenaivānugṛhṇāti kiṃ kiṃ yanna carācaram tenāvīro@pi śaṅkādiyuktaḥ kāruṇiko@pica

plain_english: Never adopt a harming thought in the victim rite; this is a great benefit to the bound soul, though it may be unpleasant at that time.
sanskrit_cite: na hiṃsābuddhimādadhyātpaśukarmaṇi jātucit paśormahopakāro@yaṃ tadātve@pyapriyaṃ bhavet

plain_english: Disease-cutting, medicine, austerity, and use are an example here; as stated in the glorious Mrtyunjaya, bond-cutting is done for the bound soul.
sanskrit_cite: vyādhicchedauṣadhatapoyojanātra nidarśanam śrīmanmṛtyuñjaye proktaṃ pāśacchede kṛte paśoḥ

plain_english: By separation from the three impurities the body does not grow; by cutting the mass of merit and demerit the body falls away indeed.
sanskrit_cite: malatrayaviyogena śarīraṃ na prarohati dharmādharmaughavicchedāccharīraṃ cyacate kila

plain_english: By that this killing is not so called — initiation is variegated-formed; of the fetter-bound, separation from breaths is indeed killing.
sanskrit_cite: tenaitanmāraṇaṃ noktaṃ dīkṣeyaṃ citrarūpiṇī rūḍhapāśasya yaḥ prāṇairviyogo māraṇaṃ hi tat

plain_english: But this is yojana only — of the beast for the god, in offering; therefore relying on the god's word: give many beasts, thus.
sanskrit_cite: iyaṃ tu yojanaiva syātpaśordevāya tarpaṇe tasmāddevoktimāśritya paśūndadyādbahūniti

plain_english: Offered, body regained, offered again — six times thus — whoever here is the six-birth supreme beast.
sanskrit_cite: niveditaḥ punaḥprāptadeho bhūyoniveditaḥ ṣaṭkṛtva itthaṃ yaḥ so@tra ṣaḍjanmā paśuruttamaḥ

plain_english: As gold purified by the firing process is proclaimed — what perfection would he not himself bestow, or is he not liberated?
sanskrit_cite: yathā pākakramācchuddhaṃ hema tadvatsa kīrtitaḥ kāṃ siddhiṃ naiva vitaretsvayaṃ kiṃvā na mucyate

plain_english: It is said in the Ananda scripture: who abandons mantra-consecration, reviles initiations, gives goddesses and mantras without rule, leads astray.
sanskrit_cite: uktaṃ tvānandaśāstre yo mantrasaṃskāravāṃstyajet samayānkutsayeddevīrdadyānmantrānvinā nayāt

plain_english: Having gained initiation-mantra and the rest, deluded by son and the rest he abandons — then attaining humanity, he does so again.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣāmantrādikaṃ prāpya tyajetputrādimohitaḥ tato manuṣyatāmetya punarevaṃ karotyapi

plain_english: Thus from one to seven births — twofold, two-footed or four-footed — the beast is born for goddess-oblation purpose.
sanskrit_cite: itthamekādisaptāntajanmāsau dvividho dvipāt catuṣpādvā paśurdevīcarukārthaṃ prajāyate

plain_english: Given by the giver, through that door he goes from union to Shiva — thus considering, strange is the employment of beasts.
sanskrit_cite: dātrarpito@sau taddvārā yāti sāyujyataḥ śivam iti saṃbhāvya citraṃ tatpaśūnāṃ praviceṣṭitam

plain_english: The desired-to-be-enjoyed should not be made into that beast elsewhere — nor is this one suitable — so understanding, remove it.
sanskrit_cite: bhogyīcikīrṣitaṃ naiva kuryādanyatra taṃ paśum nāpi naiṣa bhavedyogya iti buddhvāpasārayet

plain_english: But if desire is for that beast in particular, then offer it — give so many beasts, as said by Maheshin.
sanskrit_cite: taṃ paśuṃ kiṃtu kāṅkṣā cedviśeṣe taṃ tu ḍhaukayet tāvatastānpaśūndadyāttathācoktaṃ maheśinā

plain_english: The beast's omentum and marrow, melted, from amid fire — offer to the Shakti-wheel; considered supreme offering.
sanskrit_cite: paśorvapāmedasī ca gālite vahnimadhyataḥ arpayecchakticakrāya paramaṃ tarpaṇaṃ matam

plain_english: Heart interior head shoulder liver chiefly offer — ear-coil marrow axe, the more principal — and also that.
sanskrit_cite: hṛdantramuṇḍāṃsayakṛtpradhānaṃ vinivedayet karṇikākuṇḍalīmajjaparśu mukhyataraṃ ca vā

plain_english: Then the teacher should perform the offering to the mantra circle, offer that, and then inform the lord.
sanskrit_cite: tato@gnau tarpaṇaṃ kuryānmantracakrasya daiśikaḥ tannivedya ca devāya tato vijñāpayetprabhum

plain_english: As guru, I am known by you, supreme lord, through direct dream instruction and chants from the guru's mouth.
sanskrit_cite: gurutvena tvayaivāhamājñātaḥ parameśvara sākṣātsvapnopadeśādyairjapairgurumukhena vā

plain_english: Disciples impelled by Shiva's power are to be favored by you; these of that kind have obtained from them, doing favor.
sanskrit_cite: anugrāhyāstvayā śiṣyāḥ śivaśaktipracoditāḥ tadete tadvidhāḥ prāptāstvamebhyaḥ kurvanugraham

plain_english: Absorb me by your own self rays, so that I become Shiva; then welcome Shiva's word.
sanskrit_cite: samāveśaya māṃ svātmaraśmibhiryadahaṃ śivaḥ evaṃ bhavatviti tataḥ śivoktimabhinandayet

plain_english: One should remember the self as not different from Shiva, doer of five acts, instrument of own self, mantras and form, with desire to protect.
sanskrit_cite: śivābhinnamathātmānaṃ pañcakṛtyakaraṃ smaret svātmanaḥ karaṇaṃ mantrānmūrtiṃ cānujighṛkṣayā

plain_english: Then, having bound the white turban, worship the hands in order, mutually, for burning bonds and emitting pure principle.
sanskrit_cite: tato baddhvā sitoṣṇīṣaṃ hastayorarcayetkramāt anyonyaṃ pāśadāhāya śuddhatattvavisṛṣṭaye

plain_english: By light form, worship mantras in Shiva's hand, excluding womb covering, song, limb, attendant, and seat.
sanskrit_cite: tejorūpeṇa mantrāṃśca śivahaste samarcayet garbhāvaraṇagānaṅgaparivārāsanojjhitān

plain_english: Afterward meditate on the self alone, like the moon in water; different by action condition, but sixfold different only apparently, in reality one.
sanskrit_cite: ātmānaṃ bhāvayetpaścādekakaṃ jalacandravat kṛtyopādhivaśādbhinnaṃ ṣoḍhābhinnaṃ tu vastutaḥ

plain_english: I am in the circle, witness of all actions; pure seeing indeed is imagined by me in Shambhu's circle.
sanskrit_cite: maṇḍalastho@hamevāyaṃ sākṣī cākhilakarmaṇām śuddhā hi draṣṭṛtā śambhormaṇḍale kalpitā mayā

plain_english: As fire-rite subject, I am situated in fire; when the self is kindled, mantras would be capable of the bond-burning rite.
sanskrit_cite: homādhikaraṇatvena vahnāvahamavasthitaḥ yadātmateddhā mantrāḥ syuḥ pāśaploṣavidhāvalam

plain_english: World lords called by common light form are satisfied and made to hear; they extend the small one's authority.
sanskrit_cite: sāmānyatejorūpāntarāhūtā bhuvaneśvarāḥ tarpitāḥ śrāvitāścāṇornādhikāraṃ pratanvate

plain_english: Thus the purifiable is tenfold; thirtyfold from the threefold rule of that; by purifiable-purifier difference, hundreds and twenty-one.

plain_english: Here too, by nyasa union, in purifiable sound and action, one hundred twenty-one kinds, devoid of birth and so on, becomes.
sanskrit_cite: atrāpi nyāsayogena śodhye@dhvani tathākṛteḥ śataikaviṃśatibhidā jananādyujjhitā bhavet

plain_english: Consisting of birth and so on, thus in hundredfold scripture, scripture would be seventy plus; that also from substance-knowledge difference.
sanskrit_cite: jananādimayī tāvatyevaṃ śatadṛśi śrutiḥ syātsaptatyadhikā sāpi dravyavijñānabhedataḥ

plain_english: Twofold; eighty-five would be hundreds plus eleven; from enjoyment-liberation inquiry twofold, that is declared.
sanskrit_cite: dvidheti pañcāśītiḥ syācchatānyadhikakhābdhikā bhogamokṣānusandhānāddvividhā sā prakīrtitā

plain_english: Purification of both inauspicious and auspicious things makes enjoyment twofold, with distinction across three times.
sanskrit_cite: aśubhasyaiva saṃśuddhyā śubhasyāpyatha śodhanāt dvidhā bhogaḥ śubhe śuddhiḥ kālatrayavibhedini

plain_english: Through one, two, or all powers, enjoyment becomes seven or eightfold, and guru-disciple order divides it twofold.
sanskrit_cite: ekadvisāmastyavaśātsaptadhetyaṣṭadhā bhujiḥ guruśiṣyakramātso@pi dvidhetyevaṃ vibhidyate

plain_english: Because direct initiation depends on continuity between two, its result is full; disagreement brings ruin.
sanskrit_cite: pratyakṣadīkṣaṇe yasmāddvayorekānusandhitaḥ tādṛgdīkṣāphalaṃ pūrṇaṃ visaṃvāde tu viplavaḥ

plain_english: In indirect immortal initiation, the guru alone, by the glory of action and knowledge, leads the disciple to the desired abode.
sanskrit_cite: parokṣamṛtadīkṣādau gururevānusandhimān kriyājñānamahimnā taṃ śiṣyaṃ dhāmnīpsite nayet

plain_english: When action and knowledge are undivided, their continuity is likewise; action is again divided because it is of that nature.
sanskrit_cite: avibhinne kriyājñāne karmaśuddhau tathaiva te anusandhiḥ punarbhinnaḥ karma yasmāttadātmakam

plain_english: The holy Svachanda treatise says result differs by impression distinction for disciples and guru, even when action and the rest are undivided.
sanskrit_cite: śrīmatsvacchandaśāstre ca vāsanābhedataḥ phalam śiṣyāṇāṃ ca guroścoktamabhinne@pi kriyādike

plain_english: Variety exists in enjoyment because continuity between purifier and purified produces such variety, and variety is the life of distinction.
sanskrit_cite: bhogasya śodhakācchodhyādanusandheśca tādṛśāt vaicitryamasti bhedasya vaicitryaprāṇatā yataḥ

plain_english: Thus the path purified by those same mouths is joined; wishing to enjoy some principle, he becomes enjoyer endowed with that power.
sanskrit_cite: tathāhi vaktrairyasyādhvā śuddhastaireva yojitaḥ bhoktumiṣṭe kvacittattve sa bhoktā tadbalānvitaḥ

plain_english: Here, if auspicious actions exist, enjoyment variegation is such; in action purification, variegation is otherwise.
sanskrit_cite: śubhānāṃ karmaṇāṃ cātra sadbhāve bhogacitratā tādṛgeva bhavetkarmaśuddhau tvanyaiva citratā

plain_english: Enjoyment is joined by immediate exit or by body, then by practice or at body's end; thus it is fourfold.
sanskrit_cite: bhogaśca sadya+utkrāntyā dehenaivātha saṃgataḥ tadaivābhyāsato vāpi dehānte vetyasau catuḥ

plain_english: The previous eight-division is said to become thirty-two through yoga; liberation, though one, is the seed called convention.
sanskrit_cite: prāktanāṣṭabhidā yogāddvātriṃśadbheda ucyate mokṣa eko@pi bījasya samayākhyasya tādṛśam

plain_english: For child and known quick death, devoid of power; for aged or powerful, aiming; purification is twofold by purification or non-purification.
sanskrit_cite: bālādikaṃ jñātaśīghramaraṇaṃ śaktivarjitam vṛddhaṃ voddiśya śaktaṃ vā śodhanāśodhanāddvidhā

plain_english: Mahesha speaks a command in the glorious cave concerning the guru's duty when death is near.
sanskrit_cite: sadya+utkrāntitastraidhaṃ sā cāsannamṛtau guroḥ kāryetyājñā maheśasya śrīmadgahvarabhāṣitā

plain_english: Seeing a disciple afflicted by old age and disease, the guru should transfer him and place him in the supreme principle.
sanskrit_cite: dṛṣṭvā śiṣyaṃ jarāgrastaṃ vyādhinā paripīḍitam utkramayya tatastvenaṃ paratattve niyojayet

plain_english: Thirty-five distinctions of the guru, or of guru and disciple, are declared; seventy arise from the stated twofold calculation.
sanskrit_cite: pañcatriṃśadamī bhedā gurorvā guruśiṣyayoḥ uktadvaividhyakalanātsaptatiḥ parikīrtitāḥ

plain_english: Having destroyed those previously stated initiation distinctions, the guru speaks enumeration for attainment of practiced knowledge.
sanskrit_cite: etairbhedaiḥ puroktāṃstānbhedāndīkṣāgatānguruḥ hatvā vadetprasaṃkhyānaṃ svabhyastajñānasiddhaye

plain_english: The stated number, increased by forty, should be divided by seventy, and one should calculate initiation distinctions.
sanskrit_cite: pañcāśītiśatī yā catvāriṃśatsamuttarā kathitā tāṃ saptatyā bhittvā dīkṣābhedānsvayaṃ kalayet

plain_english: Here five lakhs, ninety-seven thousand, and eight hundred initiation distinctions are given in the Malini Tantra.
sanskrit_cite: pañcakamiha lakṣāṇāṃ ca saptanavatiḥ sahasraparisaṃkhyā aṣṭau śatāni dīkṣābhedo@yaṃ mālinītantre

plain_english: Seventy-fold and thirty-fold groups, purification, one principle and beyond, attendants, six rites, and duties yield four distinctions.
sanskrit_cite: saptatidhā śoddhṛgaṇastriṃśaddhā śodhya ekatattvādiḥ sāṇḍaḥ ṣaḍadhvarūpastathetikartavyatā caturbhedā

plain_english: That knowledge composed of substance, free from birth and endowed with that, is thirty-five-fold from the union of enjoyment and liberation.
sanskrit_cite: dravyajñānamayī sā jananādivivarjitātha tadyuktā pañcatriṃśaddhā punareṣā bhogāpavargasandhānāt

plain_english: Enjoyment is thirty-two-fold by auspicious, pure, impure, and time distinctions; liberation is threefold; duty distinctions are seventy.
sanskrit_cite: yasmāddvātriṃśaddhā bhogaḥ śubhaśuddhyaśuddhikālabhidā mokṣastredhā dviguṇā saptatiritikāryatābhedāḥ

plain_english: Initiation is divided in many ways by distinctions of purifier and purified; without the purified, it is seventy-fold.
sanskrit_cite: śodhanaśodhyavibhedāditikartavyatvabhedataścaiṣā dīkṣā bahudhā bhinnā śodhyavihīnā tu saptatidhā

plain_english: From collecting mantra limb distinctions and enumerating fifteen distinctions of the purified and principles, the count arises.
sanskrit_cite: mantrāṇāṃ sakaletarasāṅganiraṅgādibhedasaṃkalanāt śyodhyasya ca tattvādeḥ pañcadaśādyuktabhedaparigaṇanāt

plain_english: The distinctions cannot be fully enumerated; unmixed distinctions exist, while mixed ones are many-fold.
sanskrit_cite: bhedānāṃ parigaṇanā na śakyate kartumityasaṃkīrṇāḥ bhedāḥ saṃkīrṇāḥ punaranye bhūyastvakāriṇo bahudhā

plain_english: Because purifier and purified distinctions exist, much remains to be done in enjoyment and accomplishment by the wise one's support.
sanskrit_cite: śodhakaśodhyādīnāṃ dvitrādivibhedasadbhāvāt bhoge sādhye yadyadbahu kartavyaṃ tadāśrayenmatimān

plain_english: Greater cause for greater fruit is no wonder; in liberation distinction remains through firm latent habit.
sanskrit_cite: kāraṇabhūyastvaṃ kila phalabhūyastvāya kiṃ citram apavarge natu bhedastenāsminvāsanādṛḍhatvajuṣā

plain_english: Even a small action is worthy of refuge; the teacher says again, when wealth, place, time and so on are present, or in knowledge alone.
sanskrit_cite: alpāpyāśrayaṇīyā kriyātha vijñānamātre vā abhinavaguptaguruḥ punarāha hi sati vittadeśakālādau

plain_english: Even in liberation, a broad collection of action and knowledge must be done, because consciousness fluctuation is varied and unsteady, joined gradually.
sanskrit_cite: apavarge@pi hi vistīrṇakarmavijñānasaṃgrahaḥ kāryaḥ cidvṛttervaicitryāccāñcalye@pi krameṇa sandhānāt

plain_english: In each thing, shiva-natured establishment necessarily occurs; this truth, extracted by me, is for the disciple.
sanskrit_cite: tasmiṃstasminvastuni rūḍhiravaśyaṃ śivātmikā bhavati tattvamidametadātmakametasmātproddhṛto mayā śiṣyaḥ

plain_english: Thus in gradual awareness even a fool becomes shiva-natured, seeing the fortunate teacher who bestows such gradual shiva grace.
sanskrit_cite: itthaṃ kramasaṃvittau mūḍho@pi śivātmako bhavati kramikatathāvidhaśivatānugrahasubhagaṃ ca daiśikaṃ paśyan

plain_english: Even a child approaches shiva state by nondifference view and devotion strength; although discriminating activity remains, initiation gives liberation at the body's end.
sanskrit_cite: śiśurapi tadabhedadṛśā bhaktibalāccābhyupaiti śivabhāvam yadyapi vikalpavṛtterapi mokṣaṃ dīkṣayaiva dehānte

plain_english: Scripture declares that although the lord speaks thus, firm latent impression remains joined; even in liberation distinction exists, born of small or great action, such as same-world status.
sanskrit_cite: śāstre provāca vibhustathāpi dṛḍhavāsanā yuktā mokṣe@pyasti viśeṣaḥ kriyālpabhūyastvajaḥ salokādiḥ

plain_english: Thus some call that unfit; varied enjoyment only would be said, during the middle of life with residual impressions, with vow lapse and so on.
sanskrit_cite: iti kecittadayuktaṃ sa vicitro bhoga eva kathitaḥ syāt saṃskāraśeṣavartanajīvitamadhye@sya samayalopādyam

plain_english: No obstacle net comes, because action abundance is not an obstacle for the liberation seeker; the person purified by seeded initiation is protected even in vow lapse and so on.
sanskrit_cite: nāyāti vighnajālaṃ kriyābahutvaṃ mumukṣostat yasmāt sabījadīkṣāsaṃskṛtapuruṣasya samayalopādye

plain_english: Liberation after enjoyment is not thus in seedless initiation; some think this fit, and scripture remembers that.
sanskrit_cite: bhukte bhogānmokṣo naivaṃ nirbījadīkṣāyām iti kecinmanyante yuktaṃ taccāpi yatsmṛtaṃ śāstre

plain_english: From transgressing the vow, O goddess, one becomes carnivorous for a hundred years.
sanskrit_cite: samayollaṅghanāddevi kravyādatvaṃ śataṃ samāḥ

plain_english: Therefore, for a dull student, sequential action beginning with extraction of principles is fitting and extensive even for liberation, when it is capable of bestowing established Shiva-bhava.
sanskrit_cite: tasmāduruśiṣyamatau śivabhāvanirūḍhivitaraṇasamartham kramikaṃ tattvoddharaṇādi karma mokṣe@pi yuktamativitatam

plain_english: But a guru always habituated in knowledge through meditation may, for the disciple's liberation, practice any means he wishes.
sanskrit_cite: yastu sadā bhāvanayā svabhyastajñānavānguruḥ sa śiśoḥ apavargāya yathecchaṃ yaṃ kaṃcidupāyamanutiṣṭhet

plain_english: Thus, in the disciple's body, the path to be purified is placed as desired, and the purifying mantra is placed above according to the principles.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ śiṣyatanau śodhyaṃ nyasyādhvānaṃ yathepsitam śodhakaṃ mantramupari nyasyettattvānusārataḥ

plain_english: By the establishment of the two matrikas, the letter sequence told before is so placed for the purification of each principle.
sanskrit_cite: dvayormātṛkayostattvasthityā varṇakramaḥ purā kathitastaṃ tathā nyasyettattattattvaviśuddhaye

plain_english: Although the letter path is declared and to be purified, it is bound and maya-born; the purifier is another, Shiva-natured and supreme speech.
sanskrit_cite: varṇādhvā yadyapi proktaḥ śodhyaḥ pāśātmakastu saḥ māyīyaḥ śodhakastvanyaḥ śivātmā paravāṅmayaḥ

plain_english: Sadyojyotis said in the commentary on Svayambhuva: indeed one sound is bound-natured, and another is Shiva-natured.
sanskrit_cite: uvāca sadyojyotiśca vṛttau svāyambhuvasya tat bāḍhameko hi pāśātmā śabdo@nyaśca śivātmakaḥ

plain_english: Therefore the fitting purifier-purified relation of that very letter is also said in the previous scripture; they embrace it thus.
sanskrit_cite: tasmāttasyaiva varṇasya yuktā śodhakaśodhyatā śrīpūrvaśāstre cāpyuktaṃ te tairāliṅgitā iti

plain_english: Having placed the faces beginning with Sadyojata and the limbs beginning with heart, five each, six times, one should perform the thirty-six placement from earth.
sanskrit_cite: sadyojātādivaktrāṇi hṛdādyaṅgāni pañca ca ṣaṭkṛtvo nyasya ṣaṭtriṃśannyāsaṃ kuryāddharāditaḥ

plain_english: By reversal of the higher and lower in earth, three steps arise; then from water to ego through the support of five and eight.
sanskrit_cite: parāparāyā vailomyāddharāyāṃ syātpadatrayam tato jalādahaṅkāre pañcāṣṭakasamāśrayāt

plain_english: Five steps are in the three named principles of intellect, root, and male color; three and one are in the two impure times; and one is in the controller.
sanskrit_cite: padāni pañca dhīmūlapuṃrāgākhye traye trayam ekaṃ tvaśuddhavitkāladvaye caikaṃ niyāmake

plain_english: One step is said here in kala and maya; in order, five steps are in vidyesvara, sadashiva, and shiva.
sanskrit_cite: kalāmāyādvaye caikaṃ padamuktamiha kramāt vidyeśvarasadāśaktiśiveṣu padapañcakam

plain_english: Nineteen steps should be the higher-lower arrangement, with halves, ones, twos, and the moon-eye pair.
sanskrit_cite: ekonaviṃśatiḥ seyaṃ padānāṃ syātparāparā sārdhaṃ caikaṃ caikaṃ sārdhaṃ dve dve śaśī dṛgatha yugmam

plain_english: The verse gives numerical counts of letters in the goddess's padas.
sanskrit_cite: trāṇi dṛgabdhiścandraḥ śrutiḥ śaśī pañca vidhumahaścandrāḥ ekānnaviṃśatau syādakṣarasaṃkhyā padeṣviyaṃ devyāḥ

plain_english: The verse defines letter counts ending at root and maya.
sanskrit_cite: haldvayayutavasucitraguparisaṃkhyātasvavarṇāyāḥ mūlāntaṃ sārdhavarṇaṃ syānmāyāntaṃ varṇamekakam

plain_english: The verse states a rule and calls a vowel in the described placement.
sanskrit_cite: śaktyantamekamaparānyāse vidhirudīritaḥ māyāntaṃ haltataḥ śaktiparyante svara ucyate

plain_english: The verse describes supreme placement in the shiva principle context.
sanskrit_cite: niṣkale śivatattve vai paro nyāsaḥ paroditaḥ parāparāpadānyeva hyaghoryādyaṣṭakadvaye

plain_english: The verse instructs placing mantras in principles according to letter counts.
sanskrit_cite: mantrāstadanusāreṇa tattveṣvetaddvayaṃ kṣipet piṇḍākṣarāṇāṃ sarveṣāṃ varṇasaṃkhyā vibhedataḥ

plain_english: The verse arranges remainders and seeds across all principles.
sanskrit_cite: avyaktāntaṃ svare nyasyā śeṣaṃ śeṣeṣu yojayet bījāni sarvatattveṣu vyāptṛtvena prakalpayet

plain_english: The verse records that others accepted seed-like placement for clusters.
sanskrit_cite: piṇḍānāṃ bījavannyāsamanye tu pratipedire akṛte vātha śodhyasya nyāse vastubalāt sthiteḥ

plain_english: The verse says purifying placement purifies all purifiable.
sanskrit_cite: śodhakanyāsamātreṇa sarvaṃ śodhyaṃ viśudhyati śrīmanmṛtyuñjayādau ca kathitaṃ parameṣṭhinā

plain_english: The verse says element purification arises by placement alone.
sanskrit_cite: adhunā nyāsamātreṇa bhūtaśuddhiḥ prajāyate dehaśuddhyarthamapyetattulyametena vastutaḥ

plain_english: The verse questions why a stated thing is not taken elsewhere.
sanskrit_cite: anyaprakaraṇoktaṃ yadyuktaṃ prakaraṇāntare jñāpakatvena sākṣādvā tatkiṃ nānyatra gṛhyate

plain_english: The verse identifies a formerly declared placement.
sanskrit_cite: mālinīmātṛkāṅgasya nyāso yo@rcāvidhau purā proktaḥ kevalasaṃśoddhṛmantranyāse sa eva tu

plain_english: The verse gives a count involving ear padas.
sanskrit_cite: tripadī dvayordvayoḥ syātpratyekamathāṣṭasu śrutipadāni dikcandracandrarasaraviśaraśaradṛgdṛṅmṛgāṅkaśaśigaṇane

plain_english: In the placement of the pure purifying mantra, by the goddess's glory, eighteen fingers measure one foot, while another foot has another measure.
sanskrit_cite: aṅgulamāne devyā aṣṭādaśa vaibhavena padamanyat aparaṃ mānamidaṃ syāt kevalaśodhakamanunyāse

plain_english: From the fourth foot in the six-foot context, two measures called supreme and inferior are twelve and twelve, with another as before above the principles.
sanskrit_cite: turyapadātpadaṣaṭke mānadvitayaṃ parāparaparākhyam dvādaśakaṃ dvādaśakaṃ tattvopari pūrvavattvanyat

plain_english: According to the intent of pure purifying mantra placement, the great god again declares a placement opposite to that principle-order placement.
sanskrit_cite: kevalaśodhakamantranyāsābhiprāyato mahādevaḥ tattvakramoditamapi nyāsaṃ punarāha tadviruddhamapi

plain_english: In the partless, the foot is one syllable up to three in the earthly context; by such and so on, the principle-gone order placement is declared.
sanskrit_cite: niṣkale padamekārṇaṃ yāvattrīṇi tu pārthive ityādinā tattvagatakramanyāsa udīritaḥ

plain_english: Again in the Mālinī Tantra, from the distinction of class and knowledge, the lord says the feet are in two ways and describes another kind of named placement.
sanskrit_cite: punaśca mālinītantre vargavidyāvibhedataḥ dvidhā padānītyuktvākhyannyāsamanyādṛśaṃ vibhuḥ

plain_english: Each is to be known as two fingers; there the first three feet are eight fingers, four, ten fingers thence beyond.
sanskrit_cite: ekaikaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ tatra pūrvaṃ padatrayam aṣṭāṅgulāni catvāri daśāṅgulamataḥ param

plain_english: In two fingers there are two feet and other; six fingers thence beyond; and twelve fingers other, two in five fingers separate.
sanskrit_cite: dvyaṅgule dve pade cānye ṣaḍaṅgulamataḥ param dvādaśāṅgulamanyacca dve@nye pañcāṅgule pṛthak

plain_english: Two feet are four-jointed, and other two are two-jointed; thus the independent placement of the supreme-inferior goddess is called.
sanskrit_cite: padadvayaṃ catuṣparva tathānye dve dviparvaṇī evaṃ parāparādevyāḥ svatantro nyāsa ucyate

plain_english: To show that the two knowledges are joined in the disciple's body by pervader-ness only, no separate placement was formed.
sanskrit_cite: vidyādvayaṃ śiṣyatanau vyāptṛtvenaiva yojayet iti darśayituṃ nāsya pṛthaṅnyāsaṃ nyarūpayat

plain_english: Thus in the placement of the purifying mantra, from its ray union the noose-net would dissolve, from the meditation power of the teacher.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ śodhakamantrasya nyāse tadraśmiyogataḥ pāśajālaṃ vilīyeta taddhyānabalato guroḥ

plain_english: In the principle to be purified, for all sources at the same time, from birth and enjoyment, at the destruction of action there would be liberation.
sanskrit_cite: śodhyatattve samastānāṃ yonīnāṃ tulyakālataḥ jananādbhogataḥ karmakṣaye syādapavṛktatā

plain_english: Wonderful with so many bodies of the atom, even for the enjoyer, the mind-connection is not clear, having universe union and separation.
sanskrit_cite: dehaistāvadbhirasyāṇościtraṃ bhokturapi sphuṭam mano@nusandhirno viśvasaṃyogapravibhāgavat

plain_english: By necessity, the mind's activity is only in the body; beyond that there is no continuity, because it is constructed through one mind and united senses.
sanskrit_cite: niyatyā manaso dehamātre vṛttistataḥ param nānusandhā yataḥ saikasvāntayuktākṣakalpitā

plain_english: Local activity and knowledge of the self occur there; that object-knowledge does not deserve continuity in other bodies.
sanskrit_cite: pradeśavṛtti ca jñānamātmanastatra tatra tat bhogyajñānaṃ nānyadeheṣvanusandhānamarhati

plain_english: When that mind's body activity certainly becomes pure through yoga, mantra, and rite, then the knower acts.
sanskrit_cite: yadā tu manasastasya dehavṛtterapi dhruvam yogamantrakriyādeḥ syādvaimalyaṃ tadvidā tadā

plain_english: As pure mind sees quickly even when far, so in initiation of understanding there is seeing of those worlds.
sanskrit_cite: yathāmalaṃ mano dūrasthitamapyāśu paśyati tathā pratyayadīkṣāyāṃ tattadbhuvanadarśanam

plain_english: When one wishes initiation free from birth and so on, then the plan 'I lift from this' is proper deliberation.
sanskrit_cite: jananādiviyuktāṃ tu yadā dīkṣāṃ cikīrṣati tadāsmāduddharāmīti yuktamūhaprakalpanam

plain_english: Even without purification, the purifier rite there by mantra performs the birth sequence free from element union.
sanskrit_cite: yadā śodhyaṃ vinā śoddhṛnyāsastatrāpi mantrataḥ jananādikramaṃ kuryāttattvasaṃśleṣavarjitam

plain_english: In the single purifier rite excluding birth and so on, only that purifier container should be imagined.
sanskrit_cite: ekākiśoddhṛnyāse ca jananādivivarjane tacchoddhṛsaṃpuṭaṃ nāma kevalaṃ parikalpayet

plain_english: In initiation by substance union, sesame, ghee, unbroken rice, and grains are offered by respective mantra for birth union and separation.
sanskrit_cite: dravyayogena dīkṣāyāṃ tilājyākṣatataṇḍulam tattanmantreṇa juhuyājjanmayogaviyogayoḥ

plain_english: When knowledge initiation is done to the disciple, then intensely by that mantra speech force one sees from the non-conceptual.
sanskrit_cite: yadā vijñānadīkṣāṃ tu kuryācchiṣyaṃ tadā bhṛśam tanmantrasaṃjalpabalāt paśyedā cāvikalpakāt

plain_english: Concept is indeed speech-composed; that reflective one is mantra-self, and reflection is pure and bondage-natured.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpaḥ kila saṃjalpamayo yatsa vimarśakaḥ mantrātmāsau vimarśaśca śuddho@pāśavatātmakaḥ

plain_english: Because eternal beginningless boon shiva identity is constructed, by its union the teacher's concept may attain shivahood.
sanskrit_cite: nityaścānādivaradaśivābhedopakalpitaḥ tadyogāddaiśikasyāpi vikalpaḥ śivatāṃ vrajet

plain_english: In shri sara shastra this is spoken by the supreme lord: comprehension of meaning is object-subject-formed.
sanskrit_cite: śrīsāraśāstre tadidaṃ parameśena bhāṣitam arthasya pratipattiryā grāhyagrāhakarūpiṇī

plain_english: That very mantra-power, spread out in the mantra continuum, is declared as mantra-power of reflection-nature.
sanskrit_cite: sā eva mantraśaktistu vitatā mantrasantatau parāmarśasvabhāvetthaṃ mantraśaktirudāhṛtā

plain_english: Reflection is twofold and divides mantras by purity and impurity; this is said in the holy Pauṣkara, and Brahma, Vishnu, and others are egg-born.
sanskrit_cite: parāmarśo dvidhā śuddhāśuddhatvānmantrabhedakaḥ uktaṃ śrīpauṣkare@nye ca brahmaviṣṇvādayo@ṇḍagāḥ

plain_english: The primary attached beings are sattvic, rajasic, and tamasic; through their impure reflection the teacher becomes absorbed in that.
sanskrit_cite: prādhānikāḥ sāñjanāste sāttvarājasatāmasāḥ tairaśuddhaparāmarśāttanmayībhāvito guruḥ

plain_english: Vaishnava and others are declared bound souls, not fit for the lord's rule; mantras standing on the pure path, such as Shiva-bhattaraka and others, are fit.
sanskrit_cite: vaiṣṇavādiḥ paśuḥ prokto na yogyaḥ patiśāsane ye mantrāḥ śuddhamārgasthāḥ śivabhaṭṭārakādayaḥ

plain_english: The teacher seen by holy Matanga and others is absorbed in that and is Shiva; but can independent speech union alone produce reflection?
sanskrit_cite: śrīmanmataṅgādidṛśā tanmayo hi guruḥ śivaḥ nanu svatantrasaṃjalpayogādastu vimarśitā

plain_english: From where before? If from reflection, from where? In determination, the first would give unwaveringness from the teacher.
sanskrit_cite: prākkutaḥ sa vimarśāccetkutaḥ so@pi nirūpaṇe ādyastathāvikalpatvapradaḥ syādupadeṣṭṛtaḥ

plain_english: If there is transmitted speech, it too comes from another teacher; in previous order, before, it is from the first teacher.
sanskrit_cite: yaḥ saṃkrānto@bhijalpaḥ syāttasyāpyanyopadeṣṭṛtaḥ pūrvapūrvakramāditthaṃ ya evādiguroḥ purā

plain_english: Speech is indeed transmitted and exists today also; let it be grasped, even if such speech by force is independent.
sanskrit_cite: saṃjalpo hyabhisaṃkrāntaḥ so@dyāpyastīti gṛhyatām yastathāvidhasaṃjalpabalātko@pi svatantrakaḥ

plain_english: Reflection is imagined; that too is indeed that self, well-determined, like pot and jar; or if difference is determined, thus.
sanskrit_cite: vimarśaḥ kalpyate so@pi tadātmaiva suniścitaḥ ghaṭakumbha itītthaṃ vā yadi bhedo nirūpyate

plain_english: That also gives other imagination and is not to be regarded; with effort it is valued, as doing thus, clearly in the fitting of imagination.
sanskrit_cite: so@pyanyakalpanādāyī hyanādṛtyaḥ prayatnataḥ paṇāyate karotīti vikalpasyocitau sphuṭam

plain_english: Hand and transmitted speech, those two, how indeed are they mixed from word to another word? By that, learning is interrupted.
sanskrit_cite: karapāṇyabhijalpau tau saṃkīryetāṃ kathaṃ kila śabdācchabdāntare tena vyutpattirvyavadhānataḥ

plain_english: But from practice, that directly reflects wonderful narrative; its reflection rises, and ancient own reflection may shine.
sanskrit_cite: vyavahārāttu sā sākṣāccitropākhyāvimarśinī tadvimarśodayaḥ prācyasvavimarśamayaḥ sphuret

plain_english: Natural awareness sets the limit for conceptualization arising from mantra meaning.
sanskrit_cite: yāvadbālasya saṃvittirakṛtrimavimarśane tena tanmantraśabdārthaviśeṣotthaṃ vikalpanam

plain_english: Mantra is honored when difference is seen through prior knowledge forms.
sanskrit_cite: śabdāntarotthādbhedena paśyatā mantra ādṛtaḥ yaccāpi bījapiṇḍāderuktaṃ prāgbodharūpakam

plain_english: Another concept is unnecessary because the mark belongs to that alone.
sanskrit_cite: tattasyaiva kuto@nyasya tatkasmādanyakalpanā etadarthaṃ guroryatnāllakṣaṇe tatra tatra tat

plain_english: The mantra-tantra expert states the mark for awakening mantra meaning.
sanskrit_cite: lakṣaṇaṃ kathitaṃ hyeṣa mantratantraviśāradaḥ tena mantrārthasaṃbodhe mantravārtikamādarāt

plain_english: In absence of a mantra-meaning knower, the guru practices mantra identification.
sanskrit_cite: ūhāpohaprayogaṃ vā sarvathā gururācaret mantrārthavidabhāve tu sarvathā mantratanmayam

plain_english: One should make a guru when practice produces equal speech through meditation.
sanskrit_cite: guruṃ kuryāt tadabhyāsāttatsaṃkalpamayo hyasau tatsamānābhisaṃjalpo yadā mantrārthabhāvanāt

plain_english: In complete equality there is no difference; purpose action follows.
sanskrit_cite: gurorbhavettadā sarvasāmye ko bheda ucyatām aṃśenāpyatha vaiṣamye na tato@rthakriyā hi sā

plain_english: By reason, one sees the same purpose action even from other speech.
sanskrit_cite: gomayātkīṭataḥ kīṭa ityevaṃ nyāyato yadā saṃjalpāntarato@pyarthakriyāṃ tāmeva paśyati

plain_english: The truthful speaker is Shiva, and what he says becomes mantra.
sanskrit_cite: tadaiṣa satyasaṃjalpaḥ śiva eveti kathyate sa yadvakti tadeva syānmantro bhogāpavargadaḥ

plain_english: This is not the position of Abhinavagupta, whose self is offered to mantra.
sanskrit_cite: naiṣo@bhinavaguptasya pakṣo mantrārpitātmanaḥ yo@rthakriyāmāha bhinnāṃ kīṭayorapi tādṛśoḥ

plain_english: A mantra-offered mind removes poison, and that mantra word is supreme.
sanskrit_cite: mantrārpitamanāḥ kiṃcidvadanyattu viṣaṃ haret tanmantra eva śabdaḥ sa paraṃ tatra ghaṭādivat

plain_english: The beautiful lover, purified by that, is satisfied in himself.
sanskrit_cite: kāntāsaṃbhogasaṃjalpasundaraḥ kāmukaḥ sadā tatsaṃskṛto@pyanyadeṣa kurvansvātmani tṛpyati

plain_english: Thus mantra-recitation-imbued, speaking even other things — unwilling too, of that form — he does the deed, certainly.
sanskrit_cite: tathā tanmantrasaṃjalpabhāvito@nyadapi bruvan anicchurapi tadrūpastathā kāryakaro dhruvam

plain_english: Imagining even one meaning — since he sees another too — poison-removing mantras and the rest, so said in the former Sri-teaching.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpayannapyekārthaṃ yato@nyadapi paśyati viṣāpahārimantrādītyuktaṃ śrīpūrvaśāsane

plain_english: Or even in poison-destruction, diversity from cause-difference — from endless effect-differences like tissue-growth it will arise.
sanskrit_cite: yadi vā viṣanāśe@pi hetubhedādvicitratā dhātvāpyāyādikānantakāryabhedādbhaviṣyati

plain_english: Thus from mantra-recitation-imagination-practice union — the to-be-meditated thing's clarity — from union with recitation-diminution.
sanskrit_cite: tadevaṃ mantrasaṃjalpavikalpābhyāsayogataḥ bhāvyavastusphuṭībhāvaḥ saṃjalpahrāsayogataḥ

plain_english: This one makes real the thing itself — not this chatter again; he takes manifestation-means — but once manifested, what use is that there?
sanskrit_cite: vastveva bhāvayatyeṣa na saṃjalpamimaṃ punaḥ gṛhṇāti bhāsanopāyaṃ bhāte tatra tu tena kim

plain_english: Thus in chatter-decrease, very-clear-natured, unartificial-reflection-natured — the non-conceptual thing flashes.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ saṃjalpanirhrāse suparisphuṭatātmakam akṛttrimavimarśātma sphuredvastvavikalpakam

plain_english: And undifferentiated consciousness, just as it sees clearly — exactly so, by that selfhood even of the externally standing thing.
sanskrit_cite: nirvikalpā ca sā saṃvidyadyathā paśyati sphuṭam tattathaiva tathātmatvādvastuno@pi bahiḥsthiteḥ

plain_english: Especially for the maya-shiva-difference-holding, discussion is the liberation-means — bondage and liberation then indeed.
sanskrit_cite: viśeṣatastvamāyīyaśivatābhedaśālinaḥ mokṣe@bhyupāyaḥ saṃjalpo bandhamokṣau tataḥ kila

plain_english: Even in doubt, of the teacher enjoying properly undivided Shiva-nature — expectation until the non-conceptual is not employed.
sanskrit_cite: vikalpe@pi guroḥ samyagabhinnaśivatājuṣaḥ avikalpakaparyantapratīkṣā nopayujyate

plain_english: Of that-reflection-nature indeed is she, to be spoken as mantra-deity — near great consciousness, so said in Srigama teaching.
sanskrit_cite: tadvimarśasvabhāvā hi sā vācyā mantradevatā mahāsaṃvitsamāsannetyuktaṃ śrīgamaśāsane

plain_english: As the near-standing sufficiently accomplish success for kings and others, king-approaching, quickly — so mantras and the rest, the supreme.
sanskrit_cite: nikaṭasthā yathā rājñāmanyeṣāṃ sādhayantyalam siddhiṃ rājopagāṃ śīghramevaṃ mantrādayaḥ parām

plain_english: Pregnant with stated intent, that is said in Srimalini-mata — of mantras the characteristic — when sages asked why, indeed.
sanskrit_cite: uktābhiprāyagarbhaṃ taduktaṃ śrīmālinīmate mantrāṇāṃ lakṣaṇaṃ kasmādityukte munibhiḥ kila

plain_english: They desire yoga-oneness of thing with thing — that thing is declared knowable, for establishing rejectability and the rest.
sanskrit_cite: yogamekatvamicchanti vastuno@nyena vastunā tadvastu jñeyamityuktaṃ heyatvādiprasiddhaye

plain_english: For that accomplishment, the knowledge spoken by Shiva as described — for seeded-yoga accomplishment, mantra-characteristics too suffice.
sanskrit_cite: tatprasiddhyai śivenoktaṃ jñānaṃ yadupavarṇitam sabījayogasaṃsiddhyai mantralakṣaṇamapyalam

plain_english: And no eligibility in Shaiva yoga without initiation — by action-knowledge distinction it is declared twofold.
sanskrit_cite: na cādhikāritā dīkṣāṃ vinā yoge@sti śāṅkare kriyājñānavibhedena sā ca dvedhā nigadyate

plain_english: Twofold it is to be done, as cited by him — and yoga-eligibility would not be by this one alone.
sanskrit_cite: dvividhā sā prakartavyā tena caitadudāhṛtam naca yogādhikāritvamekamevānayā bhavet

plain_english: Also mantra-entitlement and liberation by Shiva-initiation — by this too it is declared — the yogin, for tattva-unity accomplishment.
sanskrit_cite: api mantrādhikāritvaṃ muktiśca śivadīkṣayā anenaitadapi proktaṃ yogī tattvaikyasiddhaye

plain_english: Mantra alone as root refuge, honoring the non-conceptual end — by mantra-practice accomplishing enjoyment or even liberation.
sanskrit_cite: mantramevāśrayenmūlaṃ nirvikalpāntamādṛtaḥ mantrābhyāsena bhogaṃ vā mokṣaṃ vāpi prasādhayan

plain_english: For attaining eligibility there, take initiation from the teacher — by that, whatever mantra-knowledge-yoga power, accomplish.
sanskrit_cite: tatrādhikāritālabdhyai dīkṣāṃ gṛhṇīta daiśikāt tena mantrajñānayogabalādyadyatprasādhayet

plain_english: That too — of the guru-yoked child in another tattva — initiation indeed applies to him; in consecration he is consecrated.
sanskrit_cite: tatsyādasyānyatattve@pi yuktasya guruṇā śiśoḥ dīkṣā hyasyopayujyeta saṃskriyāyāṃ sa saṃskṛtaḥ

plain_english: By own power alone the wise gains enjoyment or liberation — thereby through knowledge-yoga power, previously becoming a basic initiate.
sanskrit_cite: svabalenaiva bhogaṃ vā mokṣaṃ vā labhate budhaḥ tena vijñānayogādibalī prāk samayī bhavan

plain_english: The spiritual son would not be so great — but fitting to own strength; but who is deprived of knowledge-yoga is blind, as on a path.
sanskrit_cite: putrako vā na tāvānsyādapitu svabalocitaḥ yastu vijñānayogādivandhyaḥ so@ndho yathā pathi

plain_english: Teacher-dependent indeed in enjoyment and liberation, in every way — and initiation alone, even without knowledge of one's own inner, releases indeed, so said.
sanskrit_cite: daiśikāyatta eva syādbhoge muktau ca sarvathā dīkṣā ca kevalā jñānaṃ vināpi nijamāntaram

plain_english: Release indeed, so said by reasoning and scripture formerly — but the child considering only initiated connections, connection...
sanskrit_cite: mocikaiveti kathitaṃ yuktyā cāgamataḥ purā yastu dīkṣākṛtāmevāpekṣya yojanikāṃ śiśuḥ

plain_english: Knowledge becomes manifest in the fitting way; the yogin who takes refuge in yoga becomes united and attains identification with that reality.
sanskrit_cite: sphuṭībhūtyai taducitaṃ jñānaṃ yogamathāśritaḥ so@pi yatraiva yuktaḥ syāttanmayatvaṃ prapadyate

plain_english: Then all states depend on guru initiation, mantra, and scripture, especially for wicked beings among past, present, and future.
sanskrit_cite: gurudīkṣāmantraśāstrādhīnasarvasthitistataḥ duṣṭānāmeva sarveṣāṃ bhūtabhavyabhaviṣyatām

plain_english: Purification of actions should be done; it is not for one desiring enjoyment, while good souls are distinguished from those seeking worldly pleasures like kingdom and heaven.
sanskrit_cite: karmaṇāṃ śodhanaṃ kāryaṃ bubhukṣorna śubhātmanām yaḥ punarlaukikaṃ bhogaṃ rājyasvargādikaṃ śiśuḥ

plain_english: Having abandoned transcendent enjoyment, one desiring his enjoyment performs there a material initiation with ghee, sesame, and similar offerings, even in auspicious matters.
sanskrit_cite: tyaktvā lokottaraṃ bhogamīpsustasya śubheṣvapi tatra dravyamayīṃ dīkṣāṃ kurvannājyatilādikaiḥ

plain_english: The best teacher should offer, saying 'I purify his action'; but in knowledge-filled initiation, that becomes pure by union.
sanskrit_cite: karmāsya śodhayāmīti juhuyāddaiśikottamaḥ jñānamayyāṃ tu dīkṣāyāṃ tadviśuddhyati sandhitaḥ

plain_english: By the force of the guru rooted in self-awareness, destruction occurs; when his inauspicious actions become pure, then auspiciousness follows.
sanskrit_cite: guroḥ svasaṃvidrūḍhasya balāttatprakṣayo bhavet yadāsyāśubhakarmāṇi śuddhāni syustadā śubham

plain_english: By relying on one's own gradation in the path, this production arises, from the completion of enjoyment of fruits obtained by auspicious ripening sequence.
sanskrit_cite: svatāratamyāśrayaṇādadhvamadhye prasūtidam śubhapākakramopāttaphalabhogasamāptitaḥ

plain_english: Where this one is placed and stands, when future action is destroyed, it concerns future beings differing between the first body and another body.
sanskrit_cite: yatraiṣa yojitastatstho bhāvikarmakṣaye kṛte bhāvināṃ cādyadehasthadehāntaravibhedinām

plain_english: When the inauspicious part is purified, there is no decrease of enjoyment itself; this enjoyer constantly enjoys from the abode of maya to the end.
sanskrit_cite: aśubhāṃśaviśuddhau syādbhogasyaivānupakṣayaḥ bhuñjānasyāsya satataṃ bhogānmāyālayāntataḥ

plain_english: Nothing gives painful fruit even in the path beginning with the body; then in the abode of maya all pleasant enjoyments are enjoyed.
sanskrit_cite: na duḥkhaphaladaṃ dehādyadhvamadhye@pi kiṃcana tato māyālaye bhuktasamastasukhabhogakaḥ

plain_english: Dissolution goes in the partless and in the with-parts by the force of union; thus this knowable was told at the time of initiation, as from the guru.
sanskrit_cite: niṣkale sakale vaiti layaṃ yojanikābalāt iti prameyaṃ kathitaṃ dīkṣā kāle guroryathā
